verdict.rationale: Jeeves offers 'smart invoice scanning technology' to automate entering recipient/invoice details for global payments, and its MCP server lets AI agents pay vendors and pull statements, which together suggest some AI-assisted bill-to-payment population. However, there's no explicit documentation of an end-to-end 'read incoming bill, extract payment details, present for user review' workflow. Missing for 10: explicit description of AI reading/parsing incoming bill documents, structured extraction of payment fields, and a review/approval UI step before payment execution.
